faq: Yes. It's completely free: no sign-up, no limits, no watermark and no paid features.
Is my signature stored on a server?
No. Drawing and file creation happen right in your browser — your signature is never uploaded or stored anywhere. The site only counts anonymous visits, without cookies.
How do I get a signature with no background?
Just click PNG — the file is saved with a transparent background and cropped tightly to your signature. The PDF has no background either.
PNG or PDF — which should I use?
PNG is an image for Word, Google Docs, email and messengers. PDF is a vector file that scales without quality loss — ideal for printing and PDF editors.
Can I draw my signature on a phone?
Yes. It works on iPhone and Android — just use your finger. A stylus works great on tablets.
Is a drawn signature a legal e-signature?
It's an image of your handwritten signature. Whether it's accepted depends on your jurisdiction and the other party. For regulated electronic signatures, use a dedicated e-signature service.
How do I make my signature look better?
Sign large, filling the pad — the export is cropped to your strokes. A width of 2–4 looks natural, and blue resembles a ballpoint pen.
